= Terrain Roads Editing =
For now the tool can just edit heightmap, it has no influence on AI, it is not inserting materials, models.<br>
But we planning to extend possibilities of this tool.
<br>

== Select Path ==
[[File:RoadsEditing_selectPath.jpg|right]]

* List of paths in world 
* New path 
* Delete path 
* Unselect path 

== Road Preview Options ==
[[File:RoadsEditing_previewOptions.jpg|right]]

* Clip road preview with z-buffer 
* Draw road preview like mesh 
* Draw move helpers 
* Distance from terrain 

== Active Points ==
[[File:RoadsEditing_activePoints.jpg|right]]

* New 
* Delete 
* Move 
* Delete selected points 
<br>
<br>
